description: One workflow run, or one step of it, starting or ending; the `runs:events` entry's fields.

time.description: When it happened, in epoch seconds.
time.title: Time

phase.description: Whether the run or step started or ended.
phase.title: Phase

workflow.description: The workflow's name, unique on its scheduler.
workflow.title: Workflow

status.description: The run's status, or the step's when `step` is set.
status.title: Status

step.description: The step this entry reports; empty when it reports the run itself.
step.title: Step

depends.description: Names of the steps `step` waits on; empty when it waits on none, and needs `step`.
depends.title: Depends

instance.description: The runs adapter instance whose token pushed the entry over HTTP; empty for an entry a hook emitted.
instance.title: Instance

title: RunEvent
